jobs.title: Chairman
jobs.qualification: Master's Degree in science relating to environment or Bachelor's Degree in engineering in a discipline relating to environment, with Doctorate degree in environmental management; plus 10 years practical experience and 20 years of service. (Or Officer under State Govt/PSU/University holding analogous post or 3 years regular service in Level-13). Age limit: not exceeding 56 years.
jobs.salary: As per the prevailing Government norms
jobs.apply: Send applications in eight (8) sets in the format available on https://www.envcc.goa.gov.in/ along with self-attested photocopies of documents addressed to The Director, Department of Environment & Climate Change, Government of Goa, 4th Floor, Dempo Tower, Patto, Panaji-Goa- 403001
jobs.description: Appointment to the post of full-time Chairman in Goa State Pollution Control Board (GSPCB) on contract / deputation basis for a tenure of 3 years from the date of appointment.
